summary.intent: Continue a multi-lane effort on the Callisto repo: finalize the Python per-declaration dependency locator lane, stacked on PR #223, then run the full CI gate, commit, and open a PR.
summary.outcome: Python-lane branch was set to #223's tip, pending edits were applied (non_exhaustive DepContainer, marker assertion, shorter docs, changeset rewrite), a compile error was fixed, and the full gate passed (exit=0, 92.67% coverage). The Python-lane files were committed and pushed. The PR open and gh stack link steps had not yet happened.

repo: Stacked PRs: branch from #223's branch (fix/cargo-declaration-edges) and open the new PR with that as base, then link with `gh stack link`.
`just ci` must pass as the full gate before every PR; the Python lane gate passed at 92.67% line coverage.

Breaking API changes (DepLocator/DepContainer, DepEdge, RewriteKey, update_dependency_spec) are recorded in a 'Breaking:' changeset with `minor` because `just check-api` (cargo semver-checks) is local-only and not run in CI.
DepLocator is #[non_exhaustive] with constructors DepLocator::cargo(...) and DepLocator::python(...); DepContainer is the Python container enum (ProjectDependencies, Extra, PoetryDependencies).
Known low-severity Python lane issues: Poetry dotted-table version lines lose a trailing comment, and diagnostics duplicate per declaration.

code.finding: DepContainer needed #[non_exhaustive]; DepLocator docs were shortened to one line each.
A compile error in the first gate run (exit=101) was fixed here before the gate passed.

workflow: The background-task completion notice only reflects the wrapper script's exit, not the gate's result; read the log's own `exit=` line.
The sandbox rejects heredocs and compound git commands, so write script files (Write tool) and run them by absolute path.
When switching branches is blocked by uncommitted changes, repoint the branch at the target tip while keeping the working tree.
Stage only the lane's files and leave stray untracked tests out of the commit.

friction: `git switch -c` onto #223's branch aborted because uncommitted lane changes conflicted with it.
The first edit script attempt did not write its file and had to be redone via the Write tool.
The first full gate run failed with a compile error (exit=101) even though the completion notice said exit code 0.
Sandbox restrictions on heredocs and compound git commands require workarounds.
open_items: Open the Python-lane PR with base fix/cargo-declaration-edges and run `gh stack link`.
Post the real-tool attestation note on #216 (attestation job passed on main).
Wire the Timeout cause and add Unauthorized, RateLimited and Unreachable provider indeterminate causes.
